name: 唐太宗

points.title: 早年与起兵
points.description: 李世民出生于关陇贵族家庭，为唐高祖李渊次子。隋末天下大乱，他随父在晋阳起兵，参与攻取长安，以军功封秦王。
points.descriptionEn: Li Shimin was born into a Guanlong aristocratic family as the second son of Li Yuan, the founder of the Tang Dynasty. Amid the chaos of the late Sui period, he joined his father in the uprising at Jinyang, took part in the capture of Chang'an, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin for his military achievements.

points.placeEn: Chang'an and the Central Plains battlefields
points.title: 统一战争与玄武门之变
points.titleEn: Unification Wars and the Xuanwu Gate Incident
points.description: 唐朝建立后，李世民率军平定薛举、刘武周、王世充、窦建德等割据势力，为唐朝统一立下大功。626年，他在玄武门之变中杀死太子李建成，随后即位。
points.descriptionEn: After the founding of the Tang Dynasty, Li Shimin led campaigns to defeat rival warlords such as Xue Ju, Liu Wuzhou, Wang Shichong, and Dou Jiande, contributing greatly to Tang unification. In 626, he killed Crown Prince Li Jiancheng in the Xuanwu Gate Incident and subsequently ascended the throne.

points.title: 贞观之治
points.description: 唐太宗在位期间，任用房玄龄、杜如晦、魏征等贤臣，完善三省六部制与科举制，轻徭薄赋，发展生产，并平定东突厥、吐谷浑等，被北方各族尊为“天可汗”，史称“贞观之治”。
points.descriptionEn: During his reign, Emperor Taizong employed capable ministers such as Fang Xuanling, Du Ruhui, and Wei Zheng, refined the Three Departments and Six Ministries system and the civil service examinations, reduced taxes and corvée, promoted production, and subdued the Eastern Turks and Tuyuhun. He was honored as 'Heavenly Qaghan' by northern peoples, and his era is known as the 'Reign of Zhenguan'.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为唐太宗善于纳谏、任用贤能，开创贞观之治，为唐朝的强盛奠定基础，是中国古代明君的典范。
supporter.en: Supporters regard Emperor Taizong as a model wise ruler in ancient China, praising his willingness to accept advice, his employment of capable officials, and the Zhenguan era of good governance that laid the foundation for Tang prosperity.

critic.zh: 批评者指出玄武门之变中杀兄逼父，皇位取得方式存在道德争议；晚年亦有大兴土木、征伐高句丽等耗费民力之举。
critic.en: Critics point to the moral controversy of seizing the throne through the Xuanwu Gate Incident, in which he killed his brother and pressured his father; in his later years, he also undertook costly construction projects and campaigns against Goguryeo that burdened the populace.

objective.zh: 史学界普遍认为唐太宗是唐朝奠基与巩固的关键人物，其统治时期政治相对清明、社会趋于稳定，但对其个人权谋与晚年政策亦有客观批评。
objective.en: Historians generally consider Emperor Taizong a key figure in founding and consolidating the Tang Dynasty, noting relatively clean governance and social stability during his reign, while also offering objective criticism of his political machinations and later policies.

others.zh: 《旧唐书》称其“听断不惑，从善如流”。
others.en: The Old Book of Tang describes him as 'decisive in judgment and readily following good advice.'

othersByEn: Old Book of Tang and other historical records
